visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with brown hair in pigtails, wearing a white beret and a beige fuzzy jacket over a red top, sits on a green corduroy couch. She is looking at her smartphone. A hand enters the frame from the left, offering her a large bouquet of pink and white flowers. (2) She looks at the flowers with a skeptical expression, speaks to the camera while gesturing, and then dismisses the bouquet with a push. (3) The scene shifts to her sitting on a bed in a brightly lit room with white curtains. She is applying makeup with a compact. A hand offers her a white box for an iPhone. She looks at it, talks, and then takes the box while maintaining a questioning look. (4) She covers her eyes with her hands, then opens them to reveal a large assortment of strawberry-themed snacks, breads, and drinks spread out on a white bed. She looks extremely happy, clapping her hands and smiling widely. (5) She is then seen in various shots, showing and eating different products: a strawberry croissant, a slice of strawberry crepe cake, and a strawberry cream bread. She uses her hands and a spoon to show the textures and fillings. (6) She holds up various 7-Eleven branded packages, including strawberry chocolates and cookies, and takes bites while smiling at the camera. (7) She is shown holding two cans of strawberry-flavored drinks and later a bottle of strawberry milk. She sits on the bed surrounded by large plush toys of Hello Kitty, My Melody, and Lotso. (8) The final shots show a montage of all the strawberry products from 7-Eleven displayed together on the bed with the woman smiling and posing in the center.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Upbeat, high-tempo pop music begins instantly with a female narrator speaking in an enthusiastic, high-pitched tone. The audio is crisp and clearly post-produced in a studio. (2) A distinct 'pop' sound effect occurs when the flowers are shown. The narrator's speech rate is fast but well-articulated. (3) A 'whoosh' sound transition effect plays as the scene cuts. The music continues without interruption. (4) A bright 'ding' sound effect accompanies the appearance of the iPhone box. The vocal tone becomes slightly playful. (5) A magical 'sparkle' sound effect triggers as the strawberry spread is revealed. The BGM remains energetic. (6) A sharp 'crunch' sound effect is heard as the woman bites into the pastry, clearly synthesized for emphasis. (7) A 'plastic rustle' sound effect plays as a snack bag is opened. (8) A metallic 'click' sound is heard as a drink can is opened, followed by a liquid sound. (9) The narrator concludes with a very high-energy delivery, accompanied by a final festive stinger sound effect.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video uses a humorous POV skit about a 'Taurus woman' being difficult to please with typical gifts like flowers or phones, only to be easily won over by the vast array of strawberry-themed snacks and drinks available at 7-Eleven during their seasonal promotion.
